verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents adding issued cards to Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay, and has a dedicated digital-wallets docs page. That establishes core wallet support, but the evidence never covers push provisioning from the developer's app, the entitlements process, or in-wallet card art. The physical-card appearance customization in docs-8 is a different feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented push provisioning SDK/flow, Apple/Google entitlements process, in-wallet card art configuration, manual provisioning fallback, independent or hands-on corroboration.
